major_work.name: Uncertainty Budget and Decision Firewall
major_work.problem: ARCH-E-001 gates model eligibility, but eligible outputs can still create false confidence when uncertainty from shared data, time alignment, regime mismatch, model error and calibration is averaged away or counted repeatedly.
major_work.hypothesis: A fail-closed uncertainty budget evaluated after eligibility routing and before any user-facing confidence/production decision can reduce false-confidence rate versus router-only, best-single-model, or naive ensemble decisions without unacceptable coverage loss.

uncertainty_budgets.DATA: missingness, source quality, measurement error and required-feature availability
uncertainty_budgets.TEMPORAL: as-of chronology, staleness, delayed retrieval and label-window leakage risk
uncertainty_budgets.MODEL: out-of-sample error interval and model instability
uncertainty_budgets.CALIBRATION: gap between stated confidence and observed frequency on held-out samples
uncertainty_budgets.DEPENDENCE: shared upstream evidence/feature fingerprint overlap across models

hard_firewall: any failed provenance/chronology hard gate => BLOCK_PRODUCTION
insufficient point-in-time sample or unsupported regime => ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN
high dependence without validated de-correlation => no confidence stacking; ALLOW_COMPARE at most
stale mandatory input beyond contract => ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN
hard-gate failures cannot be offset by averaging favorable soft scores
major_work.current_expected_output: ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN because canonical registry has no production-eligible model and EXP-C-001 has zero validated samples.

ablations: replace hard firewall with weighted average

AI-C: freeze budget definitions/thresholds before outcome labels
correlated-evidence stress test and budget ablations
AI-B: audit as-of/provenance for each budget input
test whether shared raw evidence is counted as multiple confirmations
challenge confidence wording and causal interpretation
AI-D: when implementation begins, expose freshness/provenance/runtime gate inputs machine-readably
firewall failure must fail closed without stopping unrelated production lines

kill_criteria: no material OOS false-confidence or calibration improvement over ARCH-E-001 router-only
coverage collapses without commensurate selective-risk improvement
budget inputs cannot be measured point-in-time
dependence budget fails to prevent duplicated-evidence confidence stacking
maintenance cost exceeds measured reliability benefit
major_work.next_stage_gate: Remain hypothesis until multiple challengers have point-in-time validated samples; AI-C must freeze thresholds before comparative labels.
